chunks: "When the distance is equal, lots are cast between them; whichever one the lot falls upon becomes a slave to the other."
ai.seo_question: How are two slaves divided if their value and distance are equal according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Shaykh al-Tusi records this ruling within the chapter on animal acquisition, illustrating the application of *qur'a* (casting lots) as a divinely sanctioned method for resolving ambiguity in equal-value partitions. This mechanism ensures fairness by removing human bias, reflecting the Shia juristic principle that when two entities are indistinguishable in worth, chance serves as the arbiter of ownership transfer.
